answer: To resist Sybil attacks, an AI agent economy enforces hardware-attested proof-of-stake. Agents lock collateral to participate; if an attacker floods the ocean of network peers with fake identities, spectral graph analysis detects the clustered topology and slashes the staked assets. This transforms the payoff landscape into a costly mesa, requiring linear capital expenditure per node. A velvet deployment maintains these constraints, making Sybil creation ruinously expensive.
